Attached: 1 video

You ask. Your AI publishes. You share.

Cahut is a self-hosted, open source home for what your AIs make. Claude, ChatGPT or Le Chat publish documents, decks, dashboards and small sites to your own server over MCP. Each page gets its own address, and you decide who opens it. What cannot be undone, like making a page public, waits for your approval.

One Go binary, AGPL-3.0. Early, but the first version works.

https://github.com/getcahut/cahut

#selfhosted #mcp #opensource #golang
